# Minesweeper Engine

> A zero-dependency, high-performance Minesweeper engine implementing
> recursive QuadTree spatial partitioning and bit-packed state management
> for deterministic 1,000,000+ (One Million+) node grid simulation.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
